description: Get raw Reddit comments from the r/wallstreetbets daily discussion thread. Returns comments in a compact threaded format: [score] comment_text, with 2-space indentation for each reply level. Low-quality comments (negative score, very short low-score posts, bot commands) are automatically filtered out. Useful for directly analyzing retail investor sentiment, popular tickers, and trading ideas.

date.description: Specific date to get comments for (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for latest available discussion.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-1500). Default: 500

name: get_wsb_discussion
